description:
Makes template application return the issues it created, so `jit apply` reports them without loading each one from storage.

## Background

`apply_template` on the profiles facade (`crates/jit/src/commands/template.rs`) returns `(TemplateApplyResult, Vec<String>)`, whose roles map to created issue ids. `print_apply_result` in `crates/jit/src/main.rs` (called from the `Commands::Apply` arm, or from its handler under `crates/jit/src/dispatch/`) then calls `storage.load_issue(id)` per role to print titles and states. That is a storage call the CLI makes only because the mutation does not hand back what it produced.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `apply_template` returns, for each role it created, the created `Issue` alongside its role, and its warnings as today.
- [hard] REQ-02: Rendering the result of `jit apply` makes no storage call; `print_apply_result` (or its replacement) takes the returned issues.
- [hard] REQ-03: A harness test (`test_apply_template_returns_created_issues_by_role`) shows each returned issue equals the stored issue for its role, and `jit apply` human and JSON output are unchanged with existing suites passing unweakened.

## Notes

- `apply_template_with` follows the same return shape if it shares the result type.
